Want to experience the nano-texture feel of an iPad screen without making a full commitment? Astropad has launched a brand-new version of Rock Paper Pencil, which not only retains the detachable design but also adds a second writing texture.

Apple Pencil and iPad can now have a graphite feel — the all-new Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 arrives

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 pairs a nano-textured screen protector with a custom Apple Pencil tip. For the first time, buyers can choose between: the smooth feel of a ballpoint pen, or the soft, more friction-laden drag of graphite.

The new graphite tip simulates the feel of a 2B pencil, with added friction for the sketching, shading and expressive strokes artists need.

Astropad says developing this new option took roughly a year, using a standard 2B pencil as the reference benchmark. The company also says the finished product reproduces the visual and sound effects of real graphite.

Ballpoint or standard pencil feel — your choice

The original steel ballpoint tip remains, suited to writing, inking, fine-line drawing and tidy note-taking. Each Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 set now ships with four Apple Pencil tips: two ballpoint tips and two graphite tips.

The screen protector itself is unchanged. Astropad's proprietary NanoCling system uses electrostatic adhesion rather than adhesive, so it can be applied, removed and reused at will without leaving residue.

The company says the cling is stronger than a magnet, while supporting bubble-free application and easy removal. The protector's micro-texture mimics the feel of fine-grain paper, providing friction and better control.

The best matte screen protector for iPad

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is not just about swapping Apple Pencil tips or changing the screen texture — it treats the two as one integrated system. Astropad says the custom tips are purpose-built for the nano-textured protector. The new graphite tips are made from POM, while the ballpoint tips use steel.

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is on sale now at US$49.99 with free worldwide shipping. Version 3.0 is also available at a discounted price while stocks last.
